product.name: Alumni Network for Indian Colleges
product.tagline: Connects college alumni for mentorship, job referrals, and reunions with verified profiles

sections.problem_statement: Indian college graduates struggle to leverage their alumni network because existing platforms like LinkedIn are too noisy and college-managed portals lack user-friendly interfaces or active engagement. This fragmentation results in missed high-intent mentorship and job referral opportunities that are culturally gated within institutional circles. Our product solves this by creating a verified, high-trust ecosystem that maps institutional hierarchies to facilitate seamless professional networking.
target_users: Arjun, Final-year B.Tech student, IIT Delhi; struggles to find authentic career guidance from seniors working in top-tier VC firms.
Priya, Mid-level Product Manager, Unicorn Startup; wants to give back to her alma mater but finds current college outreach methods inefficient and spammy.
Dr. Sharma, Dean of Alumni Affairs, Tier-2 Engineering College; struggles to maintain an updated database for fundraising and placement coordination.
user_stories: As a final-year student, I want to filter alumni by company and domain so that I can request 1:1 mentorship sessions with relevant industry experts.
As a working professional, I want to post job referrals specifically for my college network so that I can improve the quality of candidates while earning referral bonuses.
As a Dean, I want to verify alumni profiles against graduation records so that I can maintain the integrity and exclusivity of the community.
As a user, I want to receive notifications for city-specific alumni reunions so that I can foster offline professional relationships.
As a job seeker, I want to see 'warm intro' paths via mutual alumni connections so that I can increase my chances of getting an interview call.
mvp_features: Verified Identity Engine: Integration with college databases or LinkedIn API to ensure only genuine alumni access the platform, building high trust.
Alumni Directory & Map: A searchable database filtered by graduation year, branch, and current employer to facilitate targeted networking.
Mentorship Marketplace: A structured booking system for 30-minute mentorship calls to streamline career guidance.
Referral Board: A dedicated space for alumni to post job openings, with an automated 'Notify Me' feature for specific companies or roles.
Event Management Module: Tools for alumni leads to organize city-based meetups with integrated RSVP and attendee tracking.
Privacy-First Messaging: Direct messaging capabilities with anti-spam filters, compliant with the DPDP Act for user data protection.
future_features: Alumni-led Endowment Fund: Facilitate micro-donations or scholarship funding for underprivileged students.
AI-driven Career Pathing: Suggest alumni mentors based on the user's specific career goals and skill gap analysis.
Private Job Board: Exclusive partnerships with top Indian firms to list roles specifically for the alumni network.
Corporate Partnership Portal: Enable companies to run 'Alumni Hiring Drives' directly through the platform.
success_metrics: Activation Rate: 40% of registered users completing their profile and making one connection within 7 days of signup to ensure early engagement.
Mentorship Completion: 500 successful 1:1 mentorship calls in the first 6 months to validate the core value proposition.
Referral Conversion: 10% of posted jobs resulting in a successful hire within 3 months to prove professional utility.
DAU/MAU Ratio: Maintain a 25% ratio to ensure long-term platform stickiness and community health.
assumptions: Alumni are willing to mentor juniors if the friction of finding and scheduling is removed.
College identity remains a strong enough social currency in India to drive platform adoption.
Data privacy and security (DPDP Act compliance) will be a primary concern for users, necessitating robust verification.
risks: Platform noise and spam → implement strict community guidelines and AI-based reporting tools.
Low engagement from senior alumni → create 'Alumni Spotlight' content and gamify the mentorship experience.
Data privacy breaches → conduct quarterly security audits and ensure end-to-end encryption for private messages.
sections.go_to_market: We will launch via a 'Campus Ambassador' program in top-tier engineering and management colleges to seed initial density. Our acquisition strategy leverages existing alumni WhatsApp groups to drive signups through referral incentives. The first 100 customer playbook involves manual onboarding of influential alumni 'power users' who commit to mentoring at least three students in the first month.
sections.tech_stack_suggestion: We will utilize a no-code approach using Bubble.io for the frontend and backend to allow for rapid iteration based on user feedback. We will integrate SendGrid for transactional emails and Firebase for secure, real-time authentication and database management. The architecture will be API-first to allow future integrations with LinkedIn and corporate HRIS systems.
sections.monetisation: We will offer a 'Freemium' model, with basic networking as free and a 'Premium Career' tier at ₹499/month for advanced job alerts and priority mentorship access. Colleges will pay an annual SaaS subscription fee of ₹1,00,000+ for the 'Alumni Management Module' to manage their database and fundraising. Future revenue will include B2B placement fees for companies recruiting through the platform.
